item.skycraft.relic.ad_green_treaty.desc: A pledge between Summerset and Valenwood, written on cured hide because no Bosmer will sign on paper.
item.skycraft.relic.ad_queens_gift.desc: A carved box of Summerset glass holding a silver moon-sugar spoon. A gift for the Mane, and a promise.
item.skycraft.relic.ad_veil_cipher.desc: A wax tablet of names and dates, written in a code that confuses Bosmer and Khajiit with livestock.
item.skycraft.relic.ad_viper_banner.desc: Blue-green silk worked with a coiled serpent. The Maormer fly it when they mean to burn a town.
item.skycraft.relic.aetherial_bow.desc: Auriel's own bow, waiting for its sunlit arrows.
item.skycraft.relic.akaviri_katana.desc: An Akaviri blade from the fall of Pale Pass. The steel is still bright under centuries of frost.
item.skycraft.relic.alms_purse.desc: A purse stitched with the symbols of the Nine, heavy with donations for the poor.
item.skycraft.relic.amaund_writ.desc: A writ of execution. The name on it is the Emperor's.
item.skycraft.relic.amulet_of_saarthal.d: An old Nord amulet that hums whenever it's near powerful magic.
item.skycraft.relic.ancestor_mask.desc: A bone mask from the Urshilaku burial caverns, stolen by grave robbers and recovered. It feels watched.
item.skycraft.relic.ancestor_moth.desc: Glowing moths drawn from the Ancestor Glade, which let a Moth Priest read a Scroll safely.
item.skycraft.relic.arkay_censer.desc: A small brass censer that the Temple uses to bless the resting dead. The smoke smells of cedar.
item.skycraft.relic.arvel_deed.desc: The Arvels' debts to an Imperial bank, which Orvas Dren will be delighted to buy.
item.skycraft.relic.ash_salts.desc: Bitter ingredients from the ashlands. Boiled together, they ease the blight's grip.
item.skycraft.relic.attunement_sphere.de: A humming Dwemer device that Septimus says will open the way to the Tower of Mzark.
item.skycraft.relic.black_book_epistolar: A Black Book recovered from a Dwemer ruin. It wants to be read.
item.skycraft.relic.black_book_waking.de: Bound in something that is not leather. The pages move when you aren't looking.
item.skycraft.relic.black_soul_gem.desc: A soul gem gone dark as a starless night. It can hold a mortal soul, and it wants to.
item.skycraft.relic.black_soul_star.desc: Malyn Varen's soul is trapped inside, souring the Star.
item.skycraft.relic.black_worm_orders.de: Names of Guild mages, their routes and their habits, in a careful cramped hand. Signed with a worm devouring its own tail.
item.skycraft.relic.blackwood_ledger.des: Shipments of 'tonic' paid for in Company gold and logged by an Argonian hand.
item.skycraft.relic.bravil_signet.desc: A Bravil magistrate's seal ring, heavy gold. Its owner will be very embarrassed to explain its loss.
item.skycraft.relic.brotherhood_letter.d: Orders in a Cyrodiilic cipher, sent to a Dark Brotherhood agent in Vvardenfell. The last line gives a place.
Raw ebony from the Caldera mine, weighed, sealed and stamped with the Hlaalu mark. All of it this time.
item.skycraft.relic.colony_report.desc: Falco Galenus's report on the colony: the mine, the rieklings, the smugglers, the factor, and the recovered cargo.
item.skycraft.relic.cr_ahzid_letter.desc: Promises of Forebear gold and Imperial favour to whoever holds Lord Hamaad's seat after him. Signed in Ahzid's own hand.
item.skycraft.relic.cr_anahbi_mask.desc: Beaten gold over a face that died four hundred years ago. Dented where the robbers pried at it.
item.skycraft.relic.cr_tribute_casket: Tribute Casket of the High King
item.skycraft.relic.cr_tribute_casket.de: A sealed casket of salt-silver bound for the High King's court. The raiders had not yet broken the wax.
item.skycraft.relic.crusaders_vision.des: A coal from the Shrine of the Crusader that does not burn the hand. It glows brighter near Pelinal's relics.
item.skycraft.relic.crystal_shard.desc: A shard of the Crystal Tower's living stone, stolen by Maormer raiders.
item.skycraft.relic.dagon_idol.desc: A crude red idol of the Prince of Destruction, carved by people who should have known better.
item.skycraft.relic.delphine_note.desc: 'If you want the horn, rent the attic room at the Sleeping Giant Inn. Your friend.'
item.skycraft.relic.dissident_tract.desc: A pamphlet questioning the divinity of the Three. Written with care, and with considerable courage.
item.skycraft.relic.dragonstone.desc: A slab of carved stone mapping the burial mounds of dragons across Skyrim.
item.skycraft.relic.dream_ash.desc: A pinch of fine grey ash from the slopes of Red Mountain, gathered at the place of Nibani's vision.
item.skycraft.relic.dremora_sigil.desc: A blackened iron token from the Daedra at Fort Sutch. It is warm and does not cool.
item.skycraft.relic.duel_glove.desc: A formal glove of challenge, thrown at your feet by a Hlaalu who thinks Redoran honor is a joke.
item.skycraft.relic.dulcias_ledger.desc: Notches for every goat the goblins took. She wants proof the debt is settled.
item.skycraft.relic.ebony_blade_relic.de: It grows sharper every time it betrays a friend.
item.skycraft.relic.ebony_sample.desc: A dense, gleaming chunk from the first seam of the Raven Rock mine.
item.skycraft.relic.elder_scroll_blood.d: Serana's scroll. It speaks of a bow, a prophecy, and the sun's death.
item.skycraft.relic.elder_scroll_cyrodii: Taken from the Imperial Library in the White-Gold Tower. It is impossible to read for long without the world going soft at the edges.
To look upon it is to see time itself, bent and folded. Handle with reverence.
item.skycraft.relic.elder_scroll_sun.des: Valerica's scroll, guarded in the Soul Cairn for an age.
item.skycraft.relic.eruvan_token.desc: A worn bronze disc with an Akaviri dragon's eye. Proof that the Blades sent you.
item.skycraft.relic.ervyn_confession.des: A purse of fresh coin and a note: 'For the Sarethi matter. Make sure the boy is seen near the body.' Signed only with a V.
item.skycraft.relic.eyes_of_the_falmer.d: Two great gems pried from a Dwemer statue. Worth more than most towns.
item.skycraft.relic.fb_dwarven_astrolabe: A nest of brass rings that still turn on their own, slowly, as if tracking stars no one else can see. Looted from the ruins of Stros M'Kai.
Instructions to burn the bonded warehouses of Taneth on the night of the new moon. Sealed with a crown above a sword, and no name.
Water-stained pages listing silk, glass and Imperial-bonded wine, every crate insured under the Emperor's seal.
item.skycraft.relic.fellglow_books.desc: Three volumes on the Eye of Magnus, taken from Urag's shelves by a former student.
item.skycraft.relic.finns_lute.desc: A lute carved by the bard Finn. The strings still hold their tune.
item.skycraft.relic.first_writ.desc: A writ of honorable execution, sealed by the Morag Tong and recognised by the Grand Council. It names one person.
item.skycraft.relic.focusing_crystal.des: A lens of Dwemer glass that once focused starlight in Mzulft's Oculory.
item.skycraft.relic.forged_black_hand_or: Orders in Lucien's style, sealed with a Speaker's mark. The ink is only weeks old, and the mark is wrong.
item.skycraft.relic.fs_heart_of_hollow_e: The heart of the great bear of Purewater Run, wrapped in moss. The Reachfolk say a bear's heart remembers how to be brave.
item.skycraft.relic.fs_silver_blood_ledg: Twenty years of payments from the Silver-Blood family to 'the mine'. No ore is listed. No names, either.
item.skycraft.relic.fs_warrens_note.desc: 'The woman asks too many questions. In the market, in daylight, so the others learn. N.' Found in a killer's cot in the Warrens.
item.skycraft.relic.fyr_endorsement.desc: A single line in Divayth Fyr's hand: 'Not a fool.' From him, this is a lavish recommendation.
item.skycraft.relic.gallus_journal.desc: Written in old Falmer script. Someone in Winterhold might read it.
item.skycraft.relic.gauntlets_of_the_cru: Heavy steel gauntlets worn by Pelinal in the war against the Ayleid sorcerer-kings.
item.skycraft.relic.gb_klimmeks_bundle.d: Dried fish, salt, a wheel of hard cheese and a note in careful letters: 'For the Masters, with respect.'
item.skycraft.relic.glenmoril_heads.desc: Grim trophies. Kodlak believes burning them will free a soul from Hircine's hunt.
item.skycraft.relic.goldenglow_bill.desc: Proof that someone has quietly bought Goldenglow Estate out from under its owner.
item.skycraft.relic.gp_felling_saw.desc: A long Colovian saw with sap still drying in its teeth. The Bosmer would very much like to see it melted.
item.skycraft.relic.gp_story_knot.desc: A cord of braided sinew tied in a hundred knots. Each knot is a sentence of a story only a Spinner can read.
item.skycraft.relic.graht_seed.desc: The seed of a walking tree, pulled from the Wilderking's thorns.
item.skycraft.relic.gull_captains_log: Captain's Log of the Gilded Gull
item.skycraft.relic.gull_captains_log.de: The last page is a tally of ransoms. The handwriting gets shakier toward the end.
item.skycraft.relic.heart_shard.desc: A splinter of red crystal from the depths of Red Mountain, still humming with old power.
item.skycraft.relic.helm_of_the_crusader: Pelinal Whitestrake's helm, dented and blackened, and still warm under the dust.
item.skycraft.relic.hist_sap.desc: Amber sap from the Root Hist, free of the blight.
item.skycraft.relic.hist_sap_vial.desc: Thick, faintly warm, and sweet-smelling. Taken from a Blackwood mercenary who would not stop fighting.
item.skycraft.relic.hlaalu_rent_ledger.d: Rents owed to the Council Manor by Balmora's shopkeepers. Several pages are marked in red.
item.skycraft.relic.honningbrew_poison.d: Labeled pest poison. It is not pest poison.
item.skycraft.relic.horn_of_jurgen.desc: The plain war horn of the founder of the Greybeards' order.
item.skycraft.relic.indarys_charter.desc: Councilor Sarethi's grant of land at Bal Isra, to raise a Redoran stronghold in the House's name.
item.skycraft.relic.jagged_crown.desc: The ancient crown of Skyrim's High Kings, made of dragon teeth and bone.
Names of retired Blades across Cyrodiil, with notes on their families and habits, in Aldmeri script.
item.skycraft.relic.kd_red_wyrm_banner.d: The order's first standard: a red dragon on black. The cloth is sound after two hundred years in a tomb, which no one can quite explain.
item.skycraft.relic.kd_wyrm_tooth.desc: As long as a forearm and still warm to the touch. Proof enough for any court in the Covenant.
item.skycraft.relic.king_olaf_verse.desc: The lost Edda of King Olaf One-Eye, in his own scratchy hand.
item.skycraft.relic.kr_chancellors_purse: Freshly minted Wayrest coin, still in the wrapping of the banker who serves the Chancellor's household.
item.skycraft.relic.kr_ransom_letter.des: A demand for five thousand crowns for the safe return of Elsabet Mornay. Written in a careful hand, on very good paper. Pirates rarely own very good paper.
item.skycraft.relic.legion_orders.desc: A demand that Whiterun admit a Legion garrison.
item.skycraft.relic.lex_roster.desc: Every Guild fence and safehouse the Watch suspects, with the night each will be raided.
item.skycraft.relic.lost_strongbox.desc: A waterlogged strongbox from the lost ship, holding the colony's quarterly accounts and its pay chest.
item.skycraft.relic.lovidicus_journal.de: A nobleman's journal, its last pages written in a hand that grew stranger with each entry. One passage speaks of an orc woman and a son.
item.skycraft.relic.mace_of_the_crusader: A flanged mace blessed in Stendarr's name. Undead things flinch from its shadow.
item.skycraft.relic.magius_letters.desc: Letters arranging the sale of Company ebony to smugglers, signed in the factor's own hand.
item.skycraft.relic.marsh_heal_herbs.des: Marsh herbs that Sister Ilara can brew into a draught against the coughing sickness.
item.skycraft.relic.meridia_beacon.desc: A glowing orb that pulls you, gently, toward the Statue to Meridia.
item.skycraft.relic.miraak_note.desc: 'The usurper is in Skyrim. Go to Solstheim, find the stones, serve Miraak.' Unsigned.
item.skycraft.relic.moon_relic.desc: A silver lattice that catches both moons' light.
item.skycraft.relic.moon_sugar_crate.des: Fine moon sugar from the Dren plantation, marked as saltrice for the excise men.
item.skycraft.relic.mp_consecrated_sugar: Sugar from the temple fields, blessed under both moons. Stolen once, to be cooked into skooma. Not anymore.
A silver censer with two openings, one for each moon. It went dark when the Fane fell to the Dro-m'Athra.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_gd_gauge.desc: A knotted plumb-line weighted with a fired-clay bob, still wet an inch from the tip.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_gd_grant.desc: A strip of parchment in a lead tube, ink faded to ash, still legible: "The Cut to the road, forever."
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_gd_valve.desc: A carved clay valve, cracked down the middle and stained with a ring of old brine.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_hs_key.desc: A black stone wedge carved with a spiral, cold as a river-bottom; it fits no lock you have ever seen.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_hs_plan.desc: A bark-paper plan of the temple ring before it broke: nine stairs, nine gates, and one drawn shut with a heavy line.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_lm_contract.de: A woven-mat contract: one boat, one passenger, one sapling, one canal route marked in knotted cord.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_lm_sapling.des: A knee-high sapling in a clay pot, its leaves veined amber, its roots wrapped in a damp reed-mat. It hums.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_lm_second_ledg: A narrow ledger bound in eel-skin. Every payment is entered. Every payment is refused.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_mm_coal: A Coal From the Spiral Fire
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_mm_coal.desc: A single coal of clay-red, held in a shell tongs, which does not cool and does not burn.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_sh_cord.desc: A short length of gorge-rope, the knots tied in an old thieves' tally.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_sh_idol.desc: A hand-high idol of bridge-stone carved with a sleeping face; one eye is just slightly open.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_sr_lantern.des: A tall funeral lantern with a blue flame that never flickers.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_sr_urn.desc: A shell urn tied with white reed, warm as a held hand. It does not rattle.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_th_blade.desc: A bone-handled blade as long as a hand, curved like a claw, with a groove for sap down the middle.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_bm_th_sap.desc: A shell cup of thick gold sap, warm as breath, humming a note just below hearing.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_an_dufrane_ma: A chart of the Gold Coast annotated in three inks and four hands. The X is not where it should be, and the legend reads: Or is it?
A small brass ring in a gull's nest of rope, string and tin. It is stamped with a number, and the number is a room at the Drowned Compass.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_an_lens_cover: A hinged brass shutter, fitted over the great lens of Anvil Lighthouse. It is lamp-black on the inside and has been oiled, recently, by a careful hand.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_an_wreckers_l: A water-stained ledger listing ships, hours and tides. Three pages are headed with a name that has been thoroughly scratched out.
A hand-width of braided hemp with an iron toggle. Someone has cut it neatly, on one side only.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_br_reliquary_: Relic Case of the Talos Chapel
A lead-lined case etched with a stylised dragon. It holds three bones, each wrapped in blue wool.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_bv_charter.de: A vellum roll in a waxed tube, signed by seven fishers and one bishop. The ink is brown and the margins are full of small drawings of eels.
A square of grey paper, folded small, left under a door. The writing is neat, patient, and entirely unlike a man who cannot speak.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_ch_bark.desc: Three scraps of grey-green bark in oilcloth. Where they were cut, the heartwood underneath is black and faintly sticky, and smells of vinegar.
A small brass key the length of a finger, tied to the heron's leg with a bit of green ribbon. A tag reads: Cellar. Mabyn only.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_ch_priory_let: The Letter That Should Not Exist
A folded page sealed in plain wax. The hand is that of a dead man, the date is next year, and the address is a house that has been a ruin for thirty years.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_ch_tincture.d: A stoppered brown bottle, warm to the touch. The label, in Fenwick Thorne's cramped script, reads: for trees, not for people. Do not ask.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_cy_ash_vial.d: A glass vial stoppered with wax, the ash inside is pale and fine, and warm to the touch. The label is in Dunmeri script and means only: hearth.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_cy_house_deed: A deed for a narrow house by the old wall, signed by a landlord who has not set foot in it, and countersigned by a notary who is not listed in any Imperial register.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_ic_alessian_s: A disc of white-gold the size of a palm, stamped with a pattern of interlocked branches. It is cold, even in sunlight.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_ic_cistern_ch: A waxed canvas chart with three circles drawn on it in charcoal. Water is marked in blue chalk. Someone has underlined the third circle twice.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_ic_forged_sta: A boxwood stamp carved to print a customs-house mark. The carving is superb. That is the problem.
Seven bronze keys on a loop of eel-hide. One of them is far older than the rest and has no teeth, only a pattern of notches.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_ic_pewter_loc: A child-sized locket with a lock of fair hair inside and a name scratched on the back: Ennia.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_kv_dorrik_sta: A single fired brick, marked with a stamp that is neither Imperial nor Kvatchi. The mark looks like a lantern in a ring.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_kv_kite.desc: A kite made of old blue cloth and two dowels. The tail is made of ribbon from a Legion cloak.
A heavy leatherbound book, water-stained at the bottom of every page. Names, dates, and in the margin, small notes: lost the arch, lost the bakery, lost her sons.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_kv_paychest.d: A small iron-banded chest stamped with the arms of the Count of Kvatch. Heavy. Locked. Faintly warm.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_sk_missing_pa: A single sheet of ledger paper, cleanly cut from the binding. Four lines of figures, a seal in green wax, and a name you will recognise.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_cyr_sk_ring.desc: A thin gold band engraved with a vine. The inside reads: To my last vintage.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_alignment_len: A palm-sized disc of clear moonstone, polished flat on one side and curved on the other. Held up at the right hour, it throws both moons' light as one thin silver line across the ground.
A phial of cloudy sugar-syrup that tastes of sweet, then of iron, then of nothing at all. Three days of it make a dock-hand forget his own name.
A brass token stamped with a vat's number. Tema gives one to every hand she trusts to open the sluice. This one was found in the wrong boiler, three floors down.
A brass caravan bell with a cracked lip, still warm. Its clapper has been tied with a strip of blue cloth, as if someone wished it to be quiet.
A fired-clay seal that once bound the lid of the Third Cistern. A fingernail-wide crack runs across the face, and the crack is clean-edged: cut, not broken.
A palm-sized bronze cog, hexagonal, ringed with the faintest etched hive-pattern. It was made by people who clearly thought bees were showing off.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_cub_charm.des: A little charm of two silver crescents on a thread, to be tied round a newborn's wrist at the first night when both moons show. This one has not yet been blessed.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_moon_sugar_ca: A small oak cask sealed with the Moon-Priests' pawprint. It is faintly warm, and smells of honey and of something older. The seal has been pried and mended with wax.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_mural_rubbing: A charcoal rubbing on silk of a mural: a loom of seven strands, each strand a different Rimmen guild's sign, all seven woven into one pattern that no living artisan knows how to repeat.
Ma'tisha's oldest tab-book, thick with inked paw-pads. One long page of identical prints in pale grey ink records a moon-sugar run that no honest tavern should know about.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_queen_cell: Queen Cell in a Wax Cradle
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_queen_cell.de: A sealed cradle of cream wax cut from the oldest hive of the Garden Cathedral. Inside, something very small is dreaming of flowers.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_route_book.de: A leather-bound book of caravan routes drawn on goatskin, with wells, wolves and bribes marked in three colours of ink. Half the pages are written in a code only Baandari clans know.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_sira_key_loan: A black iron key as long as a hand, warm from being carried against a priestess's heart. It opens the necropolis door, once.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_star_chart.de: A vellum star-chart of the winter sky, hand-lettered in silver ink. Someone has traced a seventh moon in faint pencil near the southern horizon.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_stolen_banner: A great saffron banner embroidered with a pair of black claws, folded over a rope. It is fraying at the edge where it was carried by someone in a hurry, and smells of rival-village woodsmoke.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_tally_stone.d: A palm-sized disc of white clay scored with two columns of notches. One column counts casks sent out under the temple's seal, the other counts casks that came back. The columns have not matched in a year.
A thick slate-bound ledger of every cistern's measure. The last four entries are written in a hand that is not Mala's.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_els_wheel_tally.d: A leather tally strap with a hundred knots. Each knot is a cart. One knot is a different colour, tied by someone who was not Khir.
A key of curling white coral, as long as a hand, that will open any lock on the flagship and, the Admiral says, any lock in the sea. It is cold, and very faintly wet, at all times.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_for_barnacled_cha: A sea-chart of waxed hide, stiff with salt and crusted with barnacles. It shows a coast no living Nord has named, and a harbour marked in a red that is not ink, with a single word beside it in the old tongue: HOME.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_for_feast_horn.de: A great curved horn of white bone, bound in iron and carved with ships. It has been blown at every feast since the settlement was founded, and has never once been blown in anger.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_for_lantern_logbo: A salt-stiff logbook written in the careful characters of an Akaviri captain. The last entry is a single line: 'The lantern on the mast is lit. No one lit it. We are not afraid.'
item.skycraft.relic.mq_for_migration_ver: A strip of whale-hide inscribed in ancient runes with a single stanza of the Migration Song, longer than any living skald can hold in a breath. Whoever sings it is said to remember a country that has not existed for a thousand years.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_for_reef_heart.de: A fist-sized lump of living coral that pulses, slowly, in bright pink and poison green. When held to the ear, it sounds like a drowned bell. It is warm. It is, very faintly, afraid.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_for_sahars_stance: A flat stone with a chalk diagram of a swordsman's feet, drawn by the master himself. The fourth stance has never been taught. It is, he says, the one a student invents.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_for_tiger_seal.de: A palm-sized jade seal carved with a tiger asleep, paw over its nose. When held to the light, a very small second tiger can be seen in its depths, which is awake, and watching the first.
A brass seal-stamp of the merchant brig Evening Gull, struck with a gull in flight. The ship's name has been filed off the back, and filed on again, in a different hand.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_ab_false_moori: A thick coil of tarred hemp, the end spliced to a floating cask and weighted with a stone. It was made to look like a pier's own line, and the splice is a very good one.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_ab_galley_lett: A waxed bundle containing a cook's last letter, written in a round, patient hand, and a plain wedding band. The letter is blotted at one corner by something that might be sea-water.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_ab_gold_ring_r: A small gold ring set with a single deep red stone, cut in the old Yokudan style, with a tiny crack in the setting where it has been dropped, forgiven and bought back.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_ds_fixed_ticke: A betting slip stamped with the arena seal and a second mark, a small gold feather, that does not appear on any other. The odds written on it are impossible.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_ds_purse.desc: A heavy leather purse stamped with the arena's dragon-and-star. It rattles with more than coin. Under the flap, a signed pledge: PAID IN FULL IF THE BOUT IS THROWN.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_ds_tally.desc: A ledger sheet ruled in the arena's colours, headed with a gladiator's name and a long column of bouts. Beside each is a figure, and the figures have been written smaller as the page goes on.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_el_beacon_flin: A matched flint and steel of a size for two hands, its handle bound in red cord. It has lit the Spire's beacon every dusk for four hundred years, and has never once been dropped.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_el_hidden_step: A figure no bigger than a thumb, carved from pale limestone, of a woman holding a lamp against her chest. She is smiling, and the lamp has a hole through it, as if for a very small flame.
A big goatskin bag, stitched with fine gut and sealed with pitch, slick with cold water. It weighs as much as a small child and slops when you walk.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_rh_false_scale: A brass hanging-scale with a fine chain and two shallow pans. One pan is weighted underneath with a thin plug of lead. It balances perfectly with nothing in it.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_rh_seventh_key: A narrow iron key as long as a finger, its bow cut in the shape of a lemon leaf. It has been polished by many thumbs.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_rh_spice_bag.d: A heavy leather bag stitched shut with red thread and waxed at the seams. It rattles very faintly, and smells of nothing at all, which is the strangest thing about it.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_rh_verse_fragm: A strip of palm-leaf inscribed with half a line in old Yokudan script. The second half has been torn away. What remains reads: "...and the hour of the returning shade is..."
A strip of palm-leaf, stained brown with date-syrup, inscribed in old Yokudan script. The end of the line is torn off mid-word.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_sm_map_half.de: The left half of a hand-drawn chart of Stros M'Kai, torn down the middle by a careful hand. The coastline is rendered with unusual love; the interior is a blank, except for a single compass rose and a cross.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_sm_map_other: The Other Half of the Map
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_sm_map_other.d: The right half of a chart of Stros M'Kai, its torn edge matching the first. It shows the hidden dock, the sea cave, and a small word in a clerk's writing: Mine.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_sn_cobalt_ledg: A heavy ledger bound in blue-dyed hide. Page after page of payments, each made in a different hand, each against a different name. The last page is blank except for a single palm-print in cobalt ink.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_sn_cobalt_samp: A torn corner of ledger paper, stained deep blue where it was dipped. The dye is not a bazaar blue. It is the colour of an old Yokudan sea-flag.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_sn_parrot_cage: A brass cage with a perch worn pale by claws. A scrap of ribbon is tied to the bars. The parrot, who is inside, is shouting about debts.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_sn_verse.desc: A scroll of fine paper bearing a verse in two hands. The first is a sword-singer's square strokes, the second a scholar's hasty slant. The verse is half finished, and each half argues with the other.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_tn_karim_verse: A square of lily-paper, folded in four, with a verse begun in a gardener's clumsy hand. Three lines are crossed out. The fourth reads only: "I have loved you since the pool was a puddle."
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_tn_margin_page: A single sheet of ship-book paper, closely written at the edges in a clerk's tiny script. Every line ends with a ship's name, and every ship's name has a small mark beside it.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_tn_stanza_dive: A line scratched onto a sea-polished shell with a diver's knife. It is the only verse in Taneth never spoken aloud.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_tn_stanza_gard: A slip of lily-paper inscribed with a single line in a gardener's careful hand. It describes the sound water makes when it has nowhere to go.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hf_tn_stanza_ship: A scrap torn from a ship-book margin, with a line in fading ink. It names a ship that was lost and a wind that took her.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_cm_clapper_scr: A curl of oiled vellum, thin as an onion skin, wrapped around the bell's clapper and stitched to it with copper wire. A grid of dots and short bars covers one side. The other is blank, and warm.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_cm_peal_key.de: A pair of bone discs on a cord, each notched along its rim. When aligned, the notches read as a sequence of change-ringing, the way a peal is written down.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_dg_double_tall: Two ledgers bound in one cover, the left lawful and the right not. Every crossing in the right column appears also in the left, twice.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_dg_finished_bo: A pair of small boots, half-stitched and never finished, in the old Daggerfall cut. The last stitch is a sloppy one, and has been picked out and redone twice.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_dg_letter.desc: A single folded sheet with no wax on it and no name on the front, held shut by a loop of green thread. It feels dangerous to carry for no reason a person could explain.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_dg_pledge_ledg: A heavy book of debts pledged against furniture, kin and kitchen tools. The pages for the Tarn family are marked with a pressed violet.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_ev_candle_proo: A short stub of pale wax, its wick burned from the bottom up. The flame had climbed rather than fallen, and left a tiny spiral of soot like a drawn question.
A plain tallow candle, half-burned, taken from the cathedral steps. It has never in its life burned upside down.
A cold rosette of grey lake-glass, no larger than a hand, its petals frozen in the instant of opening. Held up to the light it is faintly, steadily wet.
A lawful tally of salt sold, kept in a clerk's hand. At the back, where no clerk would look, a second tally in a different ink lists crates by the number of men it took to carry them.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_gp_tortoise_be: A bronze ship's bell, green with salt, its clapper tied back with a strip of oilcloth. Engraved around the rim: SHE RINGS FOR THE LOST AND THE FOUND.
A little oilskin-wrapped ledger, perfectly preserved. The ink has not run. The last entry reads: "I will leave the lamp lit. Come back when you can."
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_np_peat_diary2: A little oilskin-wrapped ledger from the Westfield cutting, perfectly preserved. Every entry ends with the same line.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_np_ship_lanter: A storm-lantern of black iron, its horn panes clouded with salt. The shutter is welded open. A line scratched into the base reads: HOME IS WHERE THIS IS LIT.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_or_ancestor_tu: A yellow orcish tusk as long as a hand, carved on its inner curve with a column of small notches. Each notch is a kill, a debt, or a name.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_or_cup_token.d: A rough iron token stamped with a cup and a fist. Seven of them make a lawful claim to the Chieftain's own cup, which is, by all accounts, very small.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_sh_banner.desc: A swallow-tailed crimson banner on a three-foot pole, its hem torn and sewn so many times that the stitching has become its own pattern.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_sh_muster_list: A long scroll of names in the Marshal's square hand, each with a column of ticks. Three names have been circled in red. The third is Sergeant Brom's.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_sh_wall_note.d: A grease-stained scrap in a soldier's print: "Something moves behind the third buttress at night. Not a man. Four of us saw it. We are not cowards. We are only not fools."
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_wy_chain_key.d: A great iron crank-key as long as a forearm, its handle polished by a century of palms. Etched into the shaft: PULL ONCE FOR THE KING, TWICE FOR THE TIDE.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_wy_false_weigh: Brass quay-weights, each stamped with a lawful mark. Each is a hair lighter than it ought to be. Together they would cheat a hundred merchants of a hundred crowns.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_wy_forged_mani: A ship's manifest with two columns, the left in a clerk's cramped hand, the right in a stranger's looping script. Where they disagree, the right column is much more interesting.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_wy_masque_diad: A silver circlet set with a single moonstone, small enough to hide in a glove. A tiny, tight crack runs through the stone, as though it has been dropped, and forgiven.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_hr_wy_ring.desc: A thin silver band, scabbed with barnacles but whole. The inside reads: Hold fast.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_ald_blade.desc: A Redoran duelling blade, its edge slick with a bitter green resin. It was not made to cut flesh. It was made to be borrowed.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_ald_proof.desc: A clay jar of resin and a Hlaalu apothecary's receipt, tied with a Redoran ribbon.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_bal_ledger1.de: A merchant prince's river ledger, warm from a fence's hands.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_bal_ledger2.de: The second ledger: a Council steward's private tallies, half in code.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_bal_ledger3.de: The third book: a bridge toll-keeper's list of whom the river owes.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_bal_letter.des: A plain letter, sealed in plain wax, addressed to nobody at all.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_eb_key.desc: A brass key with a Legion hallmark that is slightly off. It opens the south-quarter gate, and no one has noticed.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_eb_list.desc: A list of names and sums, in a quarter-folk hand, of who bought a key and at what hour the gate opened.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_mh_key.desc: A black iron key shaped like a plaza fountain, cold to the touch, warm when you stand in old Mournhold.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_mh_map.desc: A courier contract for forty crates, with a street plan inked in the margin where the crates are not meant to go.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_mh_seal.desc: A wax seal pressed into a lump of Dwemer brass; the pattern is the Palace plan, reversed.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_mm_core.desc: A blackened baffle from a heat-vent, cracked straight through; the crack is a clean line that cooling alone cannot make.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_mm_lantern.des: Sister Mavia's lantern, full of ashes from every living person who ever left a footprint in her cellar.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_nec_ash.desc: A funerary urn of grey ash, still faintly warm, still holding the shape of a hand.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_nec_deed.desc: A farm deed with one signature and an unsigned space, stained with candle-wax.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_nec_ring.desc: A plain bone-white ring engraved on the inside with a name that has been filed away.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_sad_teapot.des: A squat enamelled teapot. It hums three notes when lifted, and sulks when set down.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_sad_wager.desc: A slip of cream paper: "One tower. One item. Three days. Loser pays in an honest Telvanni currency: embarrassment."
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_viv_line.desc: A weighted cord knotted every fathom, with a stripe of fresh stone-dust at fourteen.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_viv_nephew.des: Water sold by the cistern to a plantation, under a clerk's neat hand and the Warden's own seal.
Forty oilskin umbrellas, waxed and furled. The handles rattle faintly.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_mw_viv_wheel.desc: The hand-wheel of a canton sluice, cut off its shaft with a mason's saw.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sky_helgen_ledger: A half-burned toll ledger of the Helgen gate, scorched at the edges. The last legible page lists a caravan that never passed.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_ff_gatepin.de: A heavy iron pin, as long as a forearm, the retaining pin of the gate. The cold has scarred it with fresh tool-marks.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_ff_supplies.d: A hide-lashed sledge: barley, salt, lamp-oil and a crate of dressing for a garrison on short rations.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_rr_idol.desc: A rod of black ebony as long as a forearm, humming faintly, still warm from the deep.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_rr_orders.des: A sealed order: "Hold until relieved." The date is long past; the ink is fresh.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_rr_tally.desc: A foreman's tally-stick notched forty-one times; the last seven notches are scraped away with a knife.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_sk_drum.desc: A hide drum no larger than a bowl, still tuned to a rhythm nobody remembers choosing.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_sk_verse.desc: A bone slip scratched with a verse older than the village; the last line is half-eaten by damp.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_th_beam.desc: A great curved whalebone beam, scarred and stained, the first rib ever hung in the hall.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_th_tusk.desc: A tusk as long as an arm, yellowed and scored with marks that look suspiciously like a count.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_tm_cap1.desc: A palm-sized fungus, teal and orange, still pulsing in time with your heartbeat.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_tm_cap2.desc: A grey tuft that seems to hush the air around it.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sol_tm_cap3.desc: A warm red spore-bulb that gives off the faint smell of toasted bread.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_catalogue_sli: A card-slip filed by a librarian who is not on the staff roll. The shelf-mark is correct. The library it refers to is not this one.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_courier_lette: A sealed letter in a courier's oilskin, the wax stamped with the Dominion's sun and, beneath it, a small private mark: a harbour lamp and a daughter's initial.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_drowned_bell_: A bronze bell-clapper green with weed, still faintly ringing a note too low to hear. When held to the ear it sounds like a church on the sea-floor.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_drowned_cap.d: A small knitted cap of undyed wool with a lilac ribbon, stiff with salt. A single thread in the ribbon is a different, older wool that does not belong to any Summerset flock.
A very small lantern of pale glass, its wick burnt black but never consumed. It gives off no light at all in the dark, and a very faint pearly glow in sunlight.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_eclipse_table: A folded table of predicted eclipses, written in two hands that disagree on the third line. Each hand has initialled its own correction, and each has crossed out the other's.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_eleventh_appl: A single golden apple from the disputed tree at King's Haven, heavy as a fist, warm to the touch. A ring of tiny script is pressed into its skin: the names of every orchard-dame who has ever claimed it.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_floor_crack_s: A thumb-wide sliver of balcony glass, thick as a coin, its edge as sharp as a razor. A line of fine, grey sediment runs through it that is not frost, not dust and not salt.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_gate_key.desc: An iron key green with verdigris, as long as a forearm, its bow cast as a closing wave. A salt-crust has grown over the bit, and a very small crab has made its home in the ward.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_groom_note.de: A hurried note on a torn menu-card, folded in four and pinned with a lover's hairpin. It is neatly written and unashamed.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_hem_sail: The Sail with a Name in Its Hem
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_hem_sail.desc: A small teal sail, folded in thirds and kept dry in oilcloth. Along the hem, in tiny stitches of dark thread, is a girl's name and a date. A seam inside has been mended three times by somebody who did not have to.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_knot_string.d: A length of coloured twine, knotted in a code of seventeen colours and a hundred and four knots. It is a navigator's memory, and it is wrong by exactly one knot in the middle.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_lamp_tag.desc: A brass tag from a dock lantern pole, stamped with a number that does not match any lantern in the harbour. The paint on the lantern it hung beneath was a different blue.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_last_lamp.des: A tall lantern of bone-white glass and brass, its wick fresh, its oil full, never once lit. A tag in a child's hand is tied to its handle: 'for the one who is coming'.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_lost_signet.d: A small gold signet of a rising sun over a wave, worn smooth at the edge by a nervous thumb. The heir of a very minor house of Cloudrest dropped it in the lift and has not been seen since.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_midnight_rope: A short length of bell-rope, tied in a complicated knot that unties itself and re-ties whenever it is looked away from. The knot is neither Altmer nor Psijic in make.
A sliver of mirror from the Traitor's Vault. It shows not your face, but the face you would wear if you had said yes to the last thing that tempted you.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_missing_folio: A single folio bound in grey buckram, its pages written in a hand that is somehow always slightly ahead of the reader. It lists dates that have not yet happened and names that do not yet exist.
A parchment deed in an archaic hand, leaf-stamped, granting the orchard of King's Haven 'to the two daughters of the house, jointly, for as long as the tree bears'. The word jointly has been underlined by a very patient clerk.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_orrery_gear.d: A palm-sized gear of bronze with seventeen teeth, one of them filed down and replaced by a stranger's metal. It still spins freely, though no axle is anywhere near it.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_precedent_lea: Leaf of the Ledger of Precedent

A single unbound page, gilded at the edges, written in the Chancellery's hand. It records a ruling nobody remembers and a judgment nobody has overturned. The ink has not faded in three thousand years.
A flat disc of grey-green stone, warm as a cheek. When it is dropped, it lands at a different place on the floor each time, and none of them are where it fell.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_race_banner.d: A cloth banner embroidered with a golden netch and the word WINNER in a silver thread. It has been washed many times. It does not smell of balloons or of sky. It smells faintly of a place that has no weather.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_sixteenth_pri: A prism of rose quartz no larger than a thumb, cut with sixteen faces. One face is blank. Held to the light, it throws a seventeenth colour that no one has a name for.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_sum_smuggler_mani: A ship's manifest written on thin slate-paper, with a pale blue Maormer wave-mark pressed beside every third entry. The cargo it lists is not on any customs roll.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_audience_toke: A small wooden disc stamped with the Silvenar's leaf and carved with a single word: WAIT. It is warm to the touch and, held up to the light, it flickers.
A single acorn as large as a fist, hard as iron and faintly gold. The Lorekeeper says the city planted it, once, on its first autumn, and forgot where.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_blight_sap.de: A glass phial of sap the colour of old tar. It smells faintly of rot and faintly, horribly, of honey. Birds will not land near it.
An acorn the size of a plum, from the bough that adds a floor every year. It is warm, and in your palm it twitches faintly, as if wanting to be planted.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_cut_staff.des: A straight young staff of green ash, still weeping sap at the end where it was cut. It was taken from a living tree, and the tree has been bleeding quietly ever since.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_dawn_trowel.d: A trowel of bone-white wood, its edge gilded in the waterfall's spray. The handle is worn into a shape that no human hand quite fits, as if the gardener who used it was not human.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_gap_stone.des: A hand-sized stone, smooth as an egg, wedged into a thorn-wall gap for years and worked loose only this week. The stone is cool, even in sunlight, and bears a chisel-mark no Bosmer smith would own.
A small pouch of silver-green seeds, each as small as a dewdrop, each wrapped in a scrap of moss. They are said to bloom only when planted while the sun is exactly half over the horizon.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_ground_camp_r: A long coil of oiled, hand-twisted rope, as thick as a wrist and smelling faintly of tar. The ground-camp spins it by moonlight. A tag on one end says, in a child's hand: 'For the Weave, with love'.
A hollow wagon-wheel hub packed with grey-white crystals of moon-sugar. A Bosmer tongue would find it strange; a Khajiit would weep. It is worth a very large sum, and a very small sentence.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_pact_waiver.d: A strip of green silk stamped with three leaf-seals, granting one wagon of foreign goods passage through Valenwood without felling or lighting a living tree. The ink is still faintly damp.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_plank_deed.de: A neatly-worded deed dated three generations ago, giving the shared plank of Sren Ja to 'whoever sweeps it first'. A smudge on the bottom corner could be a stamp, or a thumb.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_root_ring.des: A hoop of living wood, never withered, worn by every Root-Tender since the first. It is warm in the hand and pulses faintly, like a patient waiting.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_rotted_knot.d: A bridge-knot of black twisted fibre, cut from a failing support. Where it touched the rope, someone has packed it with a pale, damp paste that smells of wet mushrooms.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_silvenar_scro: A tightly rolled scroll bound in a ribbon of silver bark. No one has ever read it; every scribe who unrolls it finds the page blank, and every scribe who rolls it up again swears it was not.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_sound_wood_sh: A palm-sized slab of pale heartwood, warm and faintly green, cut from the healthy trunk. It hums softly when held to your ear, like a sleeper breathing.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_three_dyes.de: Three stoppered vials: moss-green, falls-silver and dawn-pink. Each was gathered where the water meets the light, and each shifts hue when you look at it from the side.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_toll_ribbon.d: A strip of silver ribbon the Silvenar's court ties round a passer's wrist when they have paid the mist-toll. Both ends are knotted. One is knotted wrongly, with a Baandari hand.
item.skycraft.relic.mq_val_wagon_deed.de: A folded deed of ownership for a small caravan wagon, the wheels of which were designed by a Dwemer and the axle by a Khajiit and the rest by whichever fool offered the lowest price.
item.skycraft.relic.nahkriin_staff.desc: Nahkriin's staff, the key that opens the portal to Sovngarde.
item.skycraft.relic.netch_jelly_jar.desc: Quivering, faintly glowing jelly from a bull netch. A Telvanni master wanted it for reasons he did not explain.
item.skycraft.relic.netch_leather_gift.d: A large, flawless netch hide, the kind a wise woman might use for a drum or a cloak.
item.skycraft.relic.oghma_infinium.desc: Hermaeus Mora's book of all knowledge. Reading it changes the reader.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_bloodline_axe.de: A broad iron axe notched by twelve generations of chiefs. Each notch has a name, and Burguk can recite them all.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_giant_knucklebon: As big as a fist, and yellow with age. Wise-women grind such bones for their charms.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_offering.desc: A tusk taken from the ogre that terrorized Wrothgar.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_old_keystone.des: A carved block from the gate of an older Orsinium, cut when the city was young and still believed it would last.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_orichalc_ore.des: A lump of green-veined ore, heavy as guilt. Forged right, it makes the hardest steel the Orcs know.
item.skycraft.relic.panteas_flute.desc: A silver flute that belonged to the College's finest musician.
item.skycraft.relic.peryite_incense.desc: Vampire dust, silver, deathbell and ruby, burned together. It smells exactly like you'd expect.
item.skycraft.relic.pilgrims_token: Pilgrim's Token of the Seven Graces
item.skycraft.relic.pilgrims_token.desc: A small clay token, stamped at each shrine of the pilgrimage. It is nearly full.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_alftand_rod.desc: A brass rod as long as a forearm. It hums faintly when held, a note that never quite ends.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_angarvunde_tusk_: A charm carved from an Orc's tusk, worn smooth by a thumb, its cord snapped.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_ansilvund_oath_b: An ancient Nord knife, too short to fight with, made only for cutting palms and sealing vows.
A disc of ground crystal set in brass. Held to the ear, it hums very faintly.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_avanchnzel_reson: A small bronze Dwemer key that hums at a single steady note when held near old machinery.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_bannermist_tower: A shuttered lantern with a hinged hood, made for sending signals in the dark.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_bilegulch_mine_p: An Orcish mining pick with a haft worn smooth by generations of hands.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_bleakwind_basin_: A dented copper cow-bell on a leather strap that has been very carefully, very gently untied by enormous fingers.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_blind_cliff_cave: A crooked knife of black stone, its handle wrapped in feathers and human hair.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_bloodlet_throne_: A long roll of vellum listing travellers taken on the Pale Pass road, in an elegant, unhurried hand.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_bloodskal_barrow: A Dunmer funerary urn banded in silver, bearing the crest of House Morvayn. It is heavier than it looks.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_boulderfall_cave: Magister Venn's ledger of bodies bought and sold, naming a junior attendant at the Riften Hall of the Dead.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_broken_helm_holl: A purple-plumed guard's helm with a deep dent over the left eye. A name is scratched inside the brow: ARNBJORN.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_broken_tower_red: A letter in a miner's careful hand, addressed to his sister in Karthwasten.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_broken_tusk_mine: A flat stone slab carved with the Jarl's seal and the boundaries of the Broken Tusk claim. A riekling has drawn a crown on it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_brood_cavern_sat: A Dunmer alchemist's leather satchel, wrapped in webbing, with two years of recipes inside.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_bthardamz_lexico: A Dwemer lexicon of bronze and crystal, the glyphs on its faces faintly warm to the touch.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_bujolds_retreat_: A carved wooden mask of a seal's face, worn smooth by three generations of Skaal hunters. The reavers scratched a price into the back of it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_castle_karstaag_: A jagged spike of ice that does not melt in the hand, taken from the fist of a frost giant. It hums faintly, like a struck bell.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_chillwind_depths: A trapper's brass compass on a Falmer thong, its needle still pointing faithfully north.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_crabbers_shanty_: A leather purse stiff with salt and river mud, heavy with a lifetime of crab money.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_cragslane_cavern: A wooden tally-stick notched forty times, with Hrongar Shatter-Shield's name burned into it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_cragwallow_slope: A silver brooch shaped like a sheaf of wheat, the kind Kynesgrove widows are buried wearing.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_cronvangr_cave_r: A thin copper ring, worn smooth, engraved inside with two names and the date of a vow.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_dainty_sload_man: True Manifest of the Dainty Sload
A sea captain's ledger page listing forty crates of skooma and the Solitude names who paid for them.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_damphall_mine_pa: A small iron-bound chest, scorched on one side. Inside, one hundred and twelve drakes and a list of eleven names.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_darkfall_cave_tu: A leather cord strung with boar tusks and a single bear claw, the mark of a Mor Khazgur hunter.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_darklight_tower_: A stoppered bottle that hums faintly with a little girl's voice. The Gnarlmother's price, never paid in full.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_darkshade_journa: A leather book of herbal receipts, its pages stained green and smelling strongly of nirnroot.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_darkwater_pass_l: A black lodestone in a brass cage that always turns its blunt end north. Chitin scratches mar the brass.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_deepwood_redoubt: A child's whistle carved in the shape of a hawk, the wood worn smooth by small hands.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_dragon_bridge_ov: A miners' ledger listing every ingot dug and every septim the Silver-Bloods still owe.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_dragon_mound_eve: A scholar's satchel stuffed with drawings of dragon mounds, measurements, and an empty honey jar.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_drelas_cottage_a: A fine alembic of Breton glass with a silver stopper, faintly sooty from a fire atronach's breath.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_elinhir_lens: Great Lens of the Serpent Tower
item.skycraft.relic.plr_elinhir_lens.des: A disc of flawless Yokudan glass as wide as a cartwheel's hub, ground before the Crossing. Stars seem to swim in it even by day.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_embershard_mine_: A heavy iron chest stamped with the Embershard mark. The miners' wages are still inside.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fahlbtharz_regul: A brass Dwemer heart the size of a ram's skull, still warm and ticking softly.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_faldars_tooth_bo: A heavy skinning knife with a handle of yellowed bone, carved with birch leaves. The badge of the Ashwood Knives' chief.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_falkreath_burial: A plain silver band, worn thin on one side. Grave earth is still caught in the setting.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fellglow_keep_am: A wooden amulet of Kynareth carved as a hawk in flight, its cord blackened and its wood scorched at one wing.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_folgunthur_rubbi: A long sheet of charcoal rubbing, every name in the barrow, damp at one corner.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_forelhost_signet: A bronze ring set with a dragon's head, cold to the touch. Beside the place it lay, eleven Nord names were cut into the stone.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_forsaken_cave_ba: A Stormcloak company banner stitched by the women of Windhelm, stiff with frost.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_amol_standa: An old blue banner with a white bear on it, smelling strongly of bandit.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_dunstad_dis: A leather case stamped with the Imperial dragon, holding troop dispositions for the Pale.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_fellhammer_: A small bronze bell, green with sea-rot, hauled up from the drowned temple of old Winterhold.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_frostmoth_s: A Legion standard, its cloth burned almost away, its bronze eagle green with two centuries of sea air.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_greenwall_t: A fat ledger bound in oiled hide. Every coin the Greenwall toll took, and every coin it paid out, is written in a careful hand. Some of the names would hang half of Riften.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_greymoor_pa: A small iron-bound chest stamped with the Legion eagle, rusted shut. Coins rattle within.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_neugrad_cof: A sealed iron coffer bearing the Legion's stamp. It holds a garrison's wages.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_snowhawk_jo: A necromancer's journal, its margins full of measurements taken from Morthal's own guards.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_fort_sungard_sta: A tarnished Legion standard, still mounted on its pole, its eagle missing one wing.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_frostflow_lighth: The great cracked lens of the Frostflow lamp, scratched by claws but still whole.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_frostmere_crypt_: A plain silver wedding band, taken from a fresh grave.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_frostmoon_crag_r: A plain silver ring on a leather thong, chewed at the knot. The inside is engraved: To S., from H., for every Loredas.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_gallows_rock_rin: A plain iron ring with a saw-tooth pattern hammered into the band. It is too large for any finger that is fully human.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_geirmunds_hall_n: A small fish carved from soapstone, with a hole for an eye, strung on a cord. Lake weed still clings to it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_glacial_cave_pic: A small pick with a haft of bone, marked with a hand and a hammer. Its head is so cold it fogs the air.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_gloombound_mine_: A heavy Orcish ring of black iron, set with a chip of raw ebony.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_gloomreach_satch: A leather satchel packed with glowing fungus caps that light the inside of your pack.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_graywinter_watch: A yew longbow with a chewed grip and a hunter's tally of kills cut into the limb. The troll did not care for it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_greywater_grotto: A web-wrapped satchel full of pale white cap mushrooms, still faintly warm from the spring.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_gyldenhul_barrow: A Skaal hunting spear with a seal's tooth bound to the shaft. The head is notched from a hard fight.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_haafingar_stormc: A letter folded and unfolded so many times its creases have gone soft as cloth.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_haknirs_shoal_br: A heavy branding iron shaped like a burning ship. The oath of thirty-one drowned men is bound to it, and it is always cold and wet.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_halldirs_cairn_p: A small bronze hammer of Zenithar on a leather thong, cold as ice to the touch.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_halted_stream_ca: A crude iron key on a loop of chain, greasy from a bandit chief's belt. It opens the miners' chains.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_hamvirs_rest_ske: A knot of red cord twisted around a wolf's tooth, the kind a young Nord wears for luck. It did not work.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_harmugstahl_note: A mage's notebook of spider-binding glyphs, the pages stiff with dried venom.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_helgen_strongbox: A small, soot-blackened box with a smith's mark on the lid. Something inside clinks softly.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_high_gate_ruins_: A leather satchel holding a three-quarters finished map of High Gate Ruins and a broken pencil.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_highpoint_tower_: A Telvanni grimoire bound in netch leather, full of star charts and notes on Red Mountain's fires.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_hillgrunds_tomb_: An ancient horn rimmed in silver and carved with ravens.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_hobs_fall_cave_c: A restricted College volume bound in grey leather. Its margins are full of Vinicia's notes.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_hrothmunds_barro: An iron key as long as a forearm, its bow shaped like a coiled serpent. It is warm, and the warmth feels like attention.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_ironback_hideout: A small statue of Talos cast from Ironback ore, rough and heavy, hidden for years under a hearthstone.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_ironbind_barrow_: Two shards of a river stone that fit together along a jagged seam. A third piece is missing.
A bronze Legion token on a broken chain, stamped with a cohort number and a dragon.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_kagrumez_key.des: A long brass Dwemer tuning fork. When struck it rings in a tone you feel in your teeth more than you hear.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_kjenstag_ruins_h: An ancient bronze horn, green with age, that hums faintly when held near the marsh.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_knifepoint_ridge: A long hunting knife with a scorched pine handle. The blade has been kept very sharp.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_kolbjorn_barrow_: A scrap of hide stamped with the Redoran Guard's seal, smeared with ash and lamp-soot. Neral's name is written on it in his father's careful hand.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_kvatch_seal_ston: A palm-sized grey stone carved with a swallow in flight, black with old soot, still faintly warm.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_labyrinthian_not: A College student's notebook of chalked lines and floor patterns from Labyrinthian, ending mid-word.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_last_vigil_reser: A small cask sealed with the black thorn. Under a false bottom, bottles of something red and sweet-smelling clink together.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_left_hand_mine_p: A well-kept mining pick with an Imperial eagle burned into the haft.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_liars_retreat_mo: A small iron strongbox, heavy with raw moonstone from Soljund's Sinkhole.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_lilmoth_strongbo: An Imperial strongbox crusted with two centuries of harbour mud, stamped with the eagle of the old Customs. It clinks.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_lost_echo_cave_l: A fine lute with the crest of the Bards College inlaid in pale wood. One string is broken.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_lower_steepfall_: A ram's horn bound in iron, carved with a hunter's name and his father's before him.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_lunds_hut_ring.d: A plain silver band, worn thin. Inside, scratched by hand: 'H. and L., Rorikstead.'
A grubby list of bribes paid to someone at Darkwater Crossing who signs himself only 'E.'
item.skycraft.relic.plr_moldering_ruins_: A child's whittling knife with a birch handle, his name scratched on the blade in uneven letters.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_morvunskar_notes: A bound sheaf of notes on binding summoned things to a living anchor. The margins are full of Elsbet's name.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_moss_mother_cave: A pale ash bow with a raven carved on the grip. Moss has begun to grow along its limbs.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_movarths_lair_ri: A plain silver band on a string, taken from a vampire's neck.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_mzinchaleft_toke: A stamped copper disc from the Rockwallow Mine, marked with the Ice-Vein family's sign.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_mzulft_rubbing.d: A charcoal rubbing of a great Dwemer plate, folded into a scholar's journal. The last pages are blank.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_necrom_urn.desc: A heavy bonemold urn, cracked but sealed, painted with the sigil of the Necrom mortuary. Something inside it is very displeased.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_nilheim_votive_b: A small brass bell, very old, that rings with a sweet and lingering note. Prayers are scratched around the rim.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_northwatch_keep_: Nine beads of dark Ironback iron on a leather thong, the ninth worn smooth by an old priest's fingers.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_northwind_mine_p: An old miner's pick with silver bands round the haft and three runes cut into it: hearth, ore, home.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_orotheim_key.des: A crude iron key on a bandit chief's belt-ring, greasy from handling.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_orphan_rock_char: A tiny cradle carved from birch, hung on a cord darkened with age.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_orphans_tear_str: Pay Chest of the Orphan's Tear
An iron strongbox stamped with the East Empire Company seal, its chain snapped at the bulkhead.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_pilgrims_trench_: A heavy bronze arm-ring green with sea-rot, said to have been worn by one of Ysgramor's Companions.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_pinemoon_cave_pa: A small iron box under an Imperial seal, still unbroken, with tooth marks on the lid.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_pinewatch_lockbo: A locked box from Gray Pine Goods. Inside, a ledger of debts that half of Falkreath would like to burn.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_ragnvald_lantern: A dented brass lantern with the name Hollow-Voice scratched into the base.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_raldbthar_regula: A brass rod in a cradle of struts that hums a low, steady note when touched.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_rannveigs_fast_o: A heavy band of black iron shaped as a wolf's mouth closing on a grey stone. It is cold, and stays cold.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_ravenscar_hollow: A small bronze cloak-clasp shaped like a horse's head, polished bright by a brother's worry.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_reach_imperial_c: A Legion courier's satchel. Its seal has been cut and pressed shut again with blue wax.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_reachwater_rock_: An Orcish axe whose haft is carved with the grudge-marks of Dushnikh Yal.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_red_road_pass_st: The Dawnstar mine's ore-money box, dented by a giant's heel. It is lighter than it should be.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_redorans_retreat: A battered leather satchel stamped with the Whiterun courier's mark. The Steward's sealed letter is still inside, unbroken.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_redwater_den_cop: A plain copper bracelet, green at the clasp, stamped with a small hearth sign.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_refugees_rest_ur: A small clay urn, crudely glazed, banded with tarnished silver. Something rattles faintly inside: kiln-tools, perhaps, or bone.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_rimerock_burrow_: An exile's journal in neat Altmeri script, full of the Dominion's business in Skyrim.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_riverwood_net_ch: A little fish of black iron, worn smooth by a father's thumb, with a broken loop where it once hung from a net.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_ruunvald_excavat: A worn iron disc on a cord, stamped with the mark of the Shor's Stone miners and a K scratched by a child's hand.
A worn amulet of Kyne on a frayed cord, once his mother's.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_septimus_signuss: A letter to the College in a cramped, feverish hand, frozen stiff in a lost courier's satchel.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_serpents_bluff_r: A box of woven briar and bone. Something inside it still beats, slowly, when held.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shadowgreen_cave: A sealed glass vial of sap that glows a faint, living green in the dark.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shimmermist_cave: A horn carved from mammoth tusk, a running elk cut along its side. It still sounds a clear, deep note.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shornhelm_orb.de: A shard of violet glass that shows, if you look into it, the dreams of children who are not yours.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_azura_ham: A small lamp of pale moonstone, carried from Ebonheart after the Red Year. Even unlit, it holds a faint glow like the sky after sunset.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_azura_mor: A pale moonstone the size of a fist. It is dull all day and glows softly, sadly, for the hour of dusk.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_boethiah_: A heavy silver ring with nine notches filed into the band, one for each challenger who drank his tea.
A Breton noble's signet ring, given to the champion of the Unbound as surety. The arms on it belong to one of the oldest houses of Daggerfall.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_clavicus_: A smooth black pebble that is always slightly too heavy. When you hold it, you can hear coins counting themselves.
A vellum contract sealed with a paw-print in red wax. It is warm to the touch, and the ink seems to shift when you aren't looking at it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_hermaeus_: A Mages Guild field journal swollen with Hist sap. The pages are stuck together, and the ink on them is still moving.
A folio bound in black leather without a title. Every time you open it, the first page is different, and none of the pages is numbered.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_hircine_b: A reed-bound spear with a bone point, the shaft carved with a family's hunting marks. It was found standing point-up in the mud.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_hircine_h: A heavy gold ring set with a boar's tusk, worn by the master of the Old Lodge. The band has been stretched, as if by a swelling hand.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_hircine_m: A great kagouti tusk, snapped long ago and grown back jagged, so that its broken end looks like a crown.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_mehrunes_: The gilded face-mask of a Temple Ordinator, defaced with soot and a crude spiked crown.
A wedge of red crystal, hot to hold, cut with the sigil of the Prince of Destruction. It hums like a struck bell.
A torch of black wood that never quite goes out. Its embers glow brighter whenever it is near a living tree.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_meridia_c: A disc of Ayleid glass the size of a palm. Under the grime it holds a faint, stubborn light, like the sky an hour before sunrise.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_molag_bal: A ring of new iron keys on a chain stamped with the crest of a fallen Dunmer House.
A ring of iron keys, rimed with frost, each one stamped with a tiny spiked mace.
A ring of black iron keys, each one cast in the shape of a shackle.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_namira_el: A pendant of black stone shaped like a moon in eclipse. It is cold, and in sunlight it casts no shadow.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_namira_va: A fishing cord tied in the knots of the Woodhearth net-menders, cut from the wrists of the two boys you freed.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_nocturnal: A small ebony box carved with a hooded figure. It is heavier than it looks, and it is never quite where you left it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_peryite_e: Caravan Bell of the Clan Ra'zhan
A brass caravan bell on a leather strap, its clapper carved like a moon. It rings out of time, always.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_peryite_h: A battered apothecary's case of green leather, stuffed with forty years of handwritten remedies. The last pages are sealed with red wax.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_sanguine_: A half-mask of green silk and vine leaves, smelling of wine. Tucked behind it is a note in a girl's careful hand.
A silver signet ring bearing a stag, lost at dice to a host with red eyes. It still smells faintly of wine.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_sheogorat: A green felt hat with a heron feather, worn at a provocative angle. It is slightly singed and smells of scamp.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrine_vaermina_: A stoppered glass vial full of something red that moves like smoke. If you put your ear to it, you can hear someone sleeping.
A wicker basket that seems empty and is heavy as stone. If you hold it to your ear you hear the town of Arenthia sleeping.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shroud_hearth_ba: A clay urn bound in tarnished silver at the neck. The ash inside is still faintly warm.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_shrouded_grove_h: A pale, warm length of living wood cut from the eldest tree of the Shrouded Grove.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_sightless_pit_ha: A tiny silver hammer on a chain, a miner's luck-charm handed from father to son.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_silverdrift_lair: A slate tablet carved with the lost closing verse of a Dawnstar saga.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_skytemple_ruins_: A finger-length crystal etched with a College master's sigil. It still smells faintly of lightning.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_sleeping_tree_ca: A stoppered flask of thick golden sap. Even the smell of it makes your eyelids heavy.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_snapleg_cave_hor: A ram's horn bound with brass. When the wind blows across it, it makes a sound almost like a voice.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_solitude_lightho: A heavy ring of brass and ground glass, scratched where it was wrenched from its cradle.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_south_shriekwind: A string of wooden beads carved with the circle of Arkay, worn smooth by worried fingers.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_southfringe_sanc: A black ledger listing the dead taken from the Falkreath graveyard, and what each was made to do.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_stalhrim_source_: A slab of deep blue stalhrim, wrapped in sacking. It is colder than anything has a right to be, and it seems to look back at you.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_statue_to_meridi: Finger bones bound with black cord around a shard of grave-stone. Meridia's light flickers near it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_stendarrs_beacon: The Vigilants' log of Stendarr's Beacon, its last entry naming 'the Redwater man'.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_stillborn_cave_c: A charm of carved antler bound with a thread of red wool, forty years on the midwives' cairn.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_stony_creek_cave: A fine fur-lined Legion cloak, recently and lovingly worn by a bandit chief.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_sundered_towers_: A Silver-Blood factor's private accounts, recording steel sold to the Forsworn.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_sunderstone_gorg: A cracked slab of grey stone carved with the circle of Arkay. It is heavier than it looks.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_swindlers_den_ca: A leather case closed with the red seal of the Fourth Legion. The seal is still unbroken.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_the_lady_stone_c: A bone comb inlaid with mother-of-pearl, green with lake weed but unbroken.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_the_lover_stone_: A small knot of braided hair, red thread and a single hawk feather.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_the_ritual_stone: A small black book of rituals and names, with grave dust pressed between its pages.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_tolvalds_cave_la: A soldier's brass lantern from the Great War, dented and soot-black. A Falmer charm of bone has been tied to its handle.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_traitors_post_le: A folded sheet addressed to 'Mother', the ink smeared where it was written in the cold.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_traitors_post_st: An iron strongbox stamped with the Stormcloak bear, lighter than it should be, but not by much.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_uttering_hills_c: A water-stained surveyor's book full of careful ridgeline sketches, signed B. Vanne, I.G.S.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_vahloks_tomb_rub: A leather satchel holding eleven charcoal rubbings of old Nordic inscriptions, a little scorched at the corners.
A round Nord shield, the hawk once painted on its face faded almost to nothing.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_volskygge_axe.de: A fisherman's woodaxe, too heavy for its last owner, its haft notched with a family's tally of winters.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_white_river_watc: A big brass key on a belt loop, sticky with spilled mead.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_widows_watch_rui: A plain ring of white whalebone, worn thin on one side by a thumb that turned it for years.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_windward_ruins_p: A fat purse of Dawnstar coin, every septim of it paid for a sachet that did nothing.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_witchmist_grove_: A small brass door-bell on a red ribbon. It rings by itself, very softly, when no one is touching it.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_wolfskull_cave_c: A ring of yellowed wolf teeth on blackened silver wire. It feels colder than it should.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_wreck_of_the_bri: A sealed box marked with a red knot, heavy with Legion pay. The lock has been tried and has held.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_wreck_of_the_pri: A small ash-urn of Dunmer make, sealed with wax and wrapped in a child's shawl.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_yngol_barrow_pro: A wolf's head in black oak, from the prow of the ship that carried Yngol to his death.
item.skycraft.relic.plr_yngvild_ring.des: A plain silver ring, worn thin on one side by thirty years of nets and oars.
item.skycraft.relic.ps_breach_shard.desc: A splinter of a breach between worlds. Raindrops hang motionless inside it.
item.skycraft.relic.ps_dream_shell.desc: A pale pearl that was in your hand when you woke. It is cool, faintly damp, and smells of sea fog.
item.skycraft.relic.ps_horologe.desc: A Psijic instrument of nested silver rings that measures not hours but the distance between what is and what might have been.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_altmer.desc: A crystal shard from a Summerset ruin.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_argonian.des: Sap from a sacred Hist tree.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_breton.desc: A spellbook taken from a coven's altar.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_dunmer.desc: Ash of a Dunmer ancestor, stolen from its family tomb.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_foreign.desc: Nobody knows who made it, or what it's for.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_imperial.des: A glowing blue Ayleid stone, full of starlight.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_khajiit.desc: Sweet, sticky and sacred. Do not lick.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_orc.desc: A crude idol, stolen from a stronghold shrine.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_redguard.des: A curved sword from an age before Hammerfell had its name.
item.skycraft.relic.raw_glass_lode.desc: Green, glittering raw glass from the Zebabi mine. Worth more than its weight in gold, and heavy enough to prove it.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_blade.desc: Broken shards of an impossibly sharp blade.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_hilt.desc: One piece of the dagger of the Prince of Destruction.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_pommel.desc: A pommel stone that glows like a coal.
item.skycraft.relic.rethan_deed.desc: A Hlaalu land grant for a manor on the Odai plateau, signed with a flourish by Councilor Curio.
item.skycraft.relic.rjorns_drum.desc: A war drum. Rjorn played it while the hagravens screamed.
item.skycraft.relic.rk_smuggled_steel.de: Blades from a Senchal forge, wrapped in oilcloth and stamped as 'pickled fish'.
item.skycraft.relic.rk_sugar_tithe.desc: The year's moon sugar, owed to a lord who has never cut a cane in his life.
item.skycraft.relic.rk_tax_chest.desc: A locked box of coin squeezed out of the farmers of Anequina. The lock is very good. The hinges are not.
item.skycraft.relic.rueful_axe.desc: Clavicus Vile wants Barbas dead with it. Barbas would rather not.
A sticky note, mostly wine stains: 'Misty Grove. Bring the staff. Bring yourself.'
item.skycraft.relic.sh_flaying_list.desc: Names of hunters, smiths and farmers who trade with Jorrvaskr. Three are crossed out in something brown.
item.skycraft.relic.sh_varek_journal.des: Plans for the Silver Hand after Krev, written in a cramped, proud hand, and a map of the old refuge where the hunters gather.
item.skycraft.relic.shehai_blade.desc: The spirit-sword of a Yokudan Ra Gada warrior, sealed in its tomb.
item.skycraft.relic.side_aka_ice_drum.de: A drumhead of pale hide, rimed with frost, that still trembles when the wind blows.
item.skycraft.relic.side_aka_oath_scroll: A silk scroll in Akaviri script, signed in old brown blood by nine names.
item.skycraft.relic.side_atm_cairn_heart: A lump of ancient ice that never melts, with something dark at its centre.
item.skycraft.relic.side_atm_hearthstone: A round stone that burns with blue flame and gives off no heat at all.
item.skycraft.relic.side_atm_ice_log.des: A logbook frozen into a block of clear ice, the last page legible through it.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_ancestral_eg: An egg-shaped river stone painted with a tribe's marks, old as the hatching-sands. Somebody stole it long ago.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_calendar_sto: A wheel of green stone carved with the turning of the marsh. It is warm, as if something inside it is still keeping time.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_cistern_flas: Cloudy water from the Saltmouth Cisterns. It smells faintly of low tide and lamp oil.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_coral_idol.d: A squat coral figure, slick to the touch, carved with too many arms. It is hollow, and someone has filled it with powdered bone.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_dream_censer: A black iron censer that still smells of poppy and burnt hair. Holding it makes your eyelids heavy.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_ebonroot_ord: Orders in a Dunmer hand: salt the roots of the Helstrom Hist before the rains. Sealed with an ash-yam crest.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_father_bones: The bones of an old Saxhleel trader, wrapped in waxed cloth and tied with a rope of green reed.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_glyph_rubbin: A rubbing of a leaning stone. The glyphs count seasons, then stop counting.
item.skycraft.relic.side_bm_harbor_purse: Imperial coin stamped with the Lilmoth harbor-tax mark, found in a Naga raider's bedroll.
